_source: Blueprint D2 (relationship + why) and Part I (caption + reaction). A thread appears as soon as both endpoint deductions are confirmed (A20).

threads.why: The bell's resonance matches the Echo Lantern's documented network behavior.
threads.caption: The bell resonance matches the machine's documented network behavior.

reaction.speaker: leela
reaction.line: Then the bell was part of the machine.

threads.why: The fixed 2:17 clocks conflict with Arun's 2:31 watch, exposing the false timeline.
threads.caption: The 2:17 freeze conflicts with Arun's 2:31 watch.

threads.why: The same figure and tools connect the apprentice to the person carrying Nia.
threads.caption: The same tools identify the fourth figure.

threads.why: The underground sluice ends beneath the lantern chamber, proving the river was displaced by the network event.
threads.caption: The hidden sluice ends beneath the lantern chamber.

threads.why: Nia's identity explains why Elias later erased the records: he was protecting the secret experiment and his guilt.
threads.caption: Nia's identity explains why the records were erased.

reaction.speaker: leela
reaction.line: He was trying to save her.

threads.why: The erased apprentice entry explains why the photograph and witness memories lost Elias's identity.
threads.caption: The deleted apprentice entry explains the missing identity.

reaction.speaker: mira
reaction.line: The name was removed, not forgotten.
